usage: 凍咖啡 is used as a noun to refer to the drink 'iced coffee'.
You can order 凍咖啡 at cafes and restaurants.
When talking about drinks, 凍咖啡 often appears with adjectives describing temperature or taste.
凍咖啡 can be used in questions like 'Do you want 凍咖啡 or not?'
When making requests, 凍咖啡 is commonly combined with polite phrases.
